transcript.text: [voice: Done, page 81 of Project Hail Mary.]
Leo! Page 81, and that's 23 pages since last night 📚 Three days in a row. What's pulling you into Project Hail Mary so far?
the problem solving. he gets stuck then works it out, couldn't stop tonight
That stuck-then-works-it-out loop is a great hook, Leo. Was there a moment tonight where you saw the solution coming before he did, or did it catch you off guard?
honestly didn't see it coming most of the time. he's stuck and i'm stuck with him, then he works it out and i want to know how
Stuck with him, then needing to know how. That's a good sign the book fits you. Pick one of his fixes from tonight and tell me how he cracked it, like you'd explain it to a friend.
